messages:
tara: FYI onboarding quickstart hit a weird "ghost silence" in the SSE stream after ~25s. client stays OPEN and never reconnects.
mike: which sample and sdk?
tara: node quickstart (eventsource-polyfill). happens in browser + ci runner. no error logs, just no events. :eyes:
mike: sounds like keepalive vs auth-refresh proxy splice. any 401s or socket close?
tara: none. logs show a blank chunk during an auth refresh window which I think gets merged and drops the last-event-id. snippet:
tara: [2026-03-20T18:11:12Z] stream: keepalive
tara: [2026-03-20T18:11:37Z] auth: refresh start
tara: [2026-03-20T18:11:37Z] stream: received blank lines
tara: [2026-03-20T18:11:38Z] auth: refresh done
tara: then silence but socket still OPEN.
mike: quick mitigation: add a tiny watchdog in sampleapp that checks lastSeen and recreates EventSource if > 2x keepalive.
tara: can you add a small README note too? new devs hit this during onboarding.
mike: yep opening a draft PR with watchdog + docs. also adding a minimal netcat-based CI repro to catch regressions.
devex-bot: @mike opened PR draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/523 (watchdog + docs + test). :rocket:
tara: thanks — will try PR build and let the onboarding flow know.
